comments.text: Starts a short beep on SID voice 1: volume 14, pulse width $400, frequency $2ef0, attack 0, decay 3, sustain 0, release 0, triangle wave with the gate on. The IRQ calls it every 32 interrupts while off_pad_beep_on is not 0.
Test bit on and off: resets the oscillator.
Stops the beep: clears off_pad_beep_on, turns the gate of SID voice 1 off and sets the test bit. read_cursor calls it when the pad is touched.
